1	# import_rifle.py - Unreal Editor Python script that imports the assault rifle from SourceArt and builds its
2	# materials. Content/ is not in git, so this script plus Rifle.blend on CENTRAL are the source of the assets.
3	# Run it through Tools/Jam/Import-Rifle.ps1 (UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=pythonscript), Editor closed, pistol imported first.
4	#
5	# Inputs, in the temporary folder GB_RIFLE_STAGE (Tools/Blender/rifle_export_fbx.py):
6	#   Export/SM_Rifle_{Body,Trigger,Magazine,WeakPointLight,AmmoDisplay}.fbx
7	#   Textures/T_Rifle_{BaseColor,EmissiveMask}.png
8	# Output: /Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Rifle/. Parameters the game sets (same names as the pistol, AGBGun):
9	#   ElementColor   (vector) the glow colour (enchant element, or the rifle's own colour)
10	#   ImbueRemaining (scalar) M_RifleAtlas: the side neon strip is split into 13 cells along the gun (UV 1 U = 0 at the
11	#                  strip's muzzle end); a cell is lit while 1 - its centre U < ImbueRemaining, so the strip drains from
12	#                  the muzzle end towards the stock, like the pistol bar. Glow off the strip (UV 1 V = 1) stays lit.
13	#   Flash          (scalar) M_RifleIndicator: the two sight lenses, 0 = off, 1 = full glow (weak-point hit)
14	#   DisplayTexture (texture) M_GunHolo (shared with the pistol): the ammo count
15	import os
16	import re
17	import unreal
18	
19	MESH_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Rifle"
20	SHARED_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Pistol"   # M_GunSolid and M_GunHolo, built by import_pistol.py
21	SOURCE_DIR = os.environ.get("GB_RIFLE_STAGE", "")
22	MESHES = ["SM_Rifle_Body", "SM_Rifle_Trigger", "SM_Rifle_Magazine", "SM_Rifle_WeakPointLight", "SM_Rifle_AmmoDisplay"]
23	STRIP_CELLS = 13
24	CELL_GAP = 0.12          # dark share at the start of each cell, so the strip reads as segments
25	STRIP_GLOW = 4.0         # emission strength of the neon in the element colour
26	INDICATOR_GLOW = 10.0
27	TEXTURES = {
28	    # name: (compression, sRGB)
29	    "T_Rifle_BaseColor": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_DEFAULT, True),
30	    "T_Rifle_EmissiveMask": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
31	}
32	MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE = 4096   # the Tripo maps at full size: at 2048 the parts nearest the camera looked blurry and soft
33	RIFLE_MINT = (0.05, 0.9, 0.6)
34	ALBEDO_SCALE = 0.8
35	ROUGH_POLYMER = 0.68
36	ROUGH_METAL = 0.36
37	METAL_DARK = 0.6
38	
39	SOLID = "M_GunSolid"
40	SLOT_MATERIALS = {
41	    "carabina_roja": ("M_RifleAtlas", {}),
42	    "Rifle_WeakPoint": ("M_RifleIndicator", {}),
43	    "Holo_AmmoDisplay": ("M_GunHolo", {}),
44	    "Rifle_Mag_Body": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.035, 0.04, 0.045), "Metallic": 0.6, "Roughness": 0.35}),
45	    "Rifle_Mag_Plate": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.72, 0.74, 0.77), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.45}),
46	    "Rifle_Mag_Glow": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.01, 0.01, 0.01), "Metallic": 0.0, "Roughness": 0.5, "Glow": 4.0}),
47	}
48	
49	MEL = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary
50	EAL = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary
51	
52	
53	def log(message):
54	    unreal.log("import_rifle: " + message)
55	
56	
57	def fail(message):
58	    unreal.log_error("import_rifle: ERROR " + message)
59	    raise RuntimeError(message)
60	
61	
62	def key(name):
63	    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower())
64	
65	
66	def run_import(filename, options=None):
67	    task = unreal.AssetImportTask()
68	    task.filename = filename
69	    task.destination_path = MESH_DIR
70	    task.automated = True
71	    task.replace_existing = True
72	    task.save = False
73	    if options is not None:
74	        task.options = options
75	    unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().import_asset_tasks([task])
76	    paths = list(task.imported_object_paths)
77	    if not paths:
78	        fail("nothing imported from %s" % filename)
79	    return paths
80	
81	
82	def import_textures():
83	    textures = {}
84	    for name, (compression, srgb) in TEXTURES.items():
85	        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Textures", name + ".png")
86	        if not os.path.isfile(source):
87	            fail("missing %s" % source)
88	        run_import(source)
89	        texture = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
90	        if not isinstance(texture, unreal.Texture2D):
91	            fail("%s did not import as a Texture2D" % name)
92	        texture.set_editor_property("compression_settings", compression)
93	        texture.set_editor_property("srgb", srgb)
94	        texture.set_editor_property("lod_group", unreal.TextureGroup.TEXTUREGROUP_WEAPON)
95	        texture.set_editor_property("max_texture_size", MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE)
96	        # Always resident: streamed, the rifle showed its lowest mip (flat, blurry) for the first second after equip.
97	        texture.set_editor_property("never_stream", True)
98	        textures[name] = texture
99	        log("texture %s %s srgb=%s max=%d" % (name, compression, srgb, MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE))
100	    return textures
101	
102	
103	def fbx_options():
104	    ui = unreal.FbxImportUI()
105	    ui.set_editor_property("import_mesh", True)
106	    ui.set_editor_property("import_as_skeletal", False)
107	    ui.set_editor_property("import_materials", False)
108	    ui.set_editor_property("import_textures", False)
109	    ui.set_editor_property("import_animations", False)
110	    ui.set_editor_property("mesh_type_to_import", unreal.FBXImportType.FBXIT_STATIC_MESH)
111	    data = ui.static_mesh_import_data
112	    data.set_editor_property("combine_meshes", True)
113	    data.set_editor_property("auto_generate_collision", False)
114	    data.set_editor_property("generate_lightmap_u_vs", False)
115	    data.set_editor_property("remove_degenerates", False)
116	    data.set_editor_property("convert_scene", True)
117	    data.set_editor_property("force_front_x_axis", False)
118	    data.set_editor_property("import_uniform_scale", 1.0)
119	    data.set_editor_property("normal_import_method", unreal.FBXNormalImportMethod.FBXNIM_IMPORT_NORMALS)
120	    return ui
121	
122	
123	def import_meshes():
124	    unreal.SystemLibrary.execute_console_command(None, "Interchange.FeatureFlags.Import.FBX false")
125	    meshes = {}
126	    for name in MESHES:
127	        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Export", name + ".fbx")
128	        if not os.path.isfile(source):
129	            fail("missing %s (run Tools/Blender/rifle_export_fbx.py)" % source)
130	        run_import(source, fbx_options())
131	        mesh = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
132	        if not isinstance(mesh, unreal.StaticMesh):
133	            fail("%s did not import as a StaticMesh" % name)
134	        meshes[name] = mesh
135	    return meshes
136	
137	
138	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- materials
139	
140	def get_or_create_material(name):
141	    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
142	    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
143	        material = EAL.load_asset(path)
144	        if not isinstance(material, unreal.Material):
145	            fail("%s exists but is not a Material" % path)
146	        MEL.delete_all_material_expressions(material)
147	        return material
148	    material = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
149	        name, MESH_DIR, unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew())
150	    if material is None:
151	        fail("could not create %s" % path)
152	    return material
153	
154	
155	class Graph(object):
156	    def __init__(self, material):
157	        self.material = material
158	
159	    def node(self, cls, x, y, **props):
160	        e = MEL.create_material_expression(self.material, cls, x, y)
161	        if e is None:
162	            fail("could not create %s" % cls.__name__)
163	        for k, v in props.items():
164	            e.set_editor_property(k, v)
165	        return e
166	
167	    def connect(self, src, out, dst, inputs):
168	        if isinstance(inputs, str):
169	            inputs = [inputs]
170	        for i in inputs:
171	            if MEL.connect_material_expressions(src, out, dst, i):
172	                return
173	        fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s.%r (inputs %s)" % (
174	            src.get_class().get_name(), out, dst.get_class().get_name(), inputs,
175	            list(MEL.get_material_expression_input_names(dst))))
176	
177	    def out(self, src, out, prop):
178	        if not MEL.connect_material_property(src, out, prop):
179	            fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s" % (src.get_class().get_name(), out, prop))
180	
181	    def scalar(self, name, x, y, value):
182	        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name, default_value=value)
183	
184	    def const(self, value, x, y):
185	        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, x, y, r=value)
186	
187	    def binary(self, cls, a, b, x, y, a_out="", b_out=""):
188	        m = self.node(cls, x, y)
189	        self.connect(a, a_out, m, "A")
190	        self.connect(b, b_out, m, "B")
191	        return m
192	
193	    def mul(self, a, b, x, y, a_out="", b_out=""):
194	        return self.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, a, b, x, y, a_out, b_out)
195	
196	    def unary(self, cls, src, x, y, src_out=""):
197	        m = self.node(cls, x, y)
198	        self.connect(src, src_out, m, ["", "Input"])
199	        return m
200	
201	    def less(self, a, b, x, y):
202	        """1 where a < b, else 0."""
203	        e = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, x, y)
204	        self.connect(a, "", e, "A")
205	        self.connect(b, "", e, "B")
206	        zero, one = self.const(0.0, x - 150, y + 120), self.const(1.0, x - 150, y + 200)
207	        self.connect(zero, "", e, ["A > B", "AGreaterThanB"])
208	        self.connect(zero, "", e, ["A == B", "AEqualsB"])
209	        self.connect(one, "", e, ["A < B", "ALessThanB"])
210	        return e
211	
212	
213	def finish(material, name):
214	    errors = MEL.recompile_material(material)
215	    if errors:
216	        for e in errors:
217	            unreal.log_error("import_rifle: ERROR compile: %s" % e)
218	        fail("%s has compile errors" % name)
219	    bad = MEL.get_material_error_expressions(material)
220	    if bad:
221	        fail("%s: %d expressions report errors" % (name, len(bad)))
222	    log("material %s" % name)
223	
224	
225	def opaque(material):
226	    # One-sided on purpose: the Tripo body has panels doubled back to back; two-sided, they z-fight and the whole
227	    # rifle looks grainy (tried, seen in the smoke screenshot).
228	    material.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_OPAQUE)
229	    material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
230	    material.set_editor_property("two_sided", False)
231	
232	
233	def surface(g, textures):
234	    """Albedo from the Tripo map; roughness and metallic derived from its brightness (no ORM). Returns the mask."""
235	    base = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, -1400, -600, texture=textures["T_Rifle_BaseColor"],
236	                  sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
237	    # The white polymer read washed out next to the pistol in the arena light: albedo x ALBEDO_SCALE.
238	    g.out(g.mul(base, g.const(ALBEDO_SCALE, -1200, -450), -900, -600, a_out="RGB"), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
239	    # No ORM in the source: the albedo's brightness tells polymer from metal. Light parts are matte white polymer
240	    # (roughness ROUGH_POLYMER, not metallic); dark parts are satin metal (ROUGH_METAL, metallic METAL_DARK). One flat
241	    # value for the whole gun made it read soft and glossy.
242	    lum = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionDotProduct, -1100, -380)
243	    g.connect(base, "RGB", lum, "A")
244	    g.connect(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -1300, -300, constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.3, 0.59, 0.11, 1.0)), "", lum, "B")
245	    light = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionSaturate,
246	                    g.mul(g.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionSubtract, lum, g.const(0.1, -1000, -260), -900, -380),
247	                          g.const(1.0 / 0.3, -900, -260), -750, -380), -600, -380)
248	    rough = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionLinearInterpolate, -400, -380)
249	    g.connect(g.const(ROUGH_METAL, -550, -300), "", rough, "A")
250	    g.connect(g.const(ROUGH_POLYMER, -550, -240), "", rough, "B")
251	    g.connect(light, "", rough, "Alpha")
252	    g.out(rough, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
253	    metal = g.mul(g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionOneMinus, light, -450, -460), g.const(METAL_DARK, -450, -520), -300, -480)
254	    g.out(metal, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
255	    return g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, -1400, -300, texture=textures["T_Rifle_EmissiveMask"],
256	                  sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_MASKS)
257	
258	
259	def element_color(g, x, y):
260	    v = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVectorParameter, x, y, parameter_name="ElementColor",
261	               default_value=unreal.LinearColor(RIFLE_MINT[0], RIFLE_MINT[1], RIFLE_MINT[2], 1.0))
262	    m = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, x + 200, y, r=True, g=True, b=True, a=False)
263	    g.connect(v, "", m, ["", "Input"])
264	    return m
265	
266	
267	def build_atlas(textures):
268	    # Body: albedo, neon mask in the element colour; on the strip (UV 1 V = 0) only lit cells glow, with thin gaps.
269	    m = get_or_create_material("M_RifleAtlas")
270	    opaque(m)
271	    g = Graph(m)
272	    mask = surface(g, textures)
273	    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -2400, 200, coordinate_index=1)
274	    u_raw = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -2200, 200, r=True, g=False, b=False, a=False)
275	    g.connect(uv, "", u_raw, ["", "Input"])
276	    off_strip = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -2200, 500, r=False, g=True, b=False, a=False)
277	    g.connect(uv, "", off_strip, ["", "Input"])
278	    u = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionSaturate, u_raw, -2000, 200)
279	    scaled = g.mul(u, g.const(float(STRIP_CELLS) * 0.99999, -2000, 320), -1850, 200)
280	    cell = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionFloor, scaled, -1700, 150)
281	    centre = g.mul(g.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionAdd, cell, g.const(0.5, -1700, 260), -1550, 150),
282	                   g.const(1.0 / STRIP_CELLS, -1550, 260), -1400, 150)
283	    from_muzzle = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionOneMinus, centre, -1250, 150)
284	    lit = g.less(from_muzzle, g.scalar("ImbueRemaining", -1250, 260, 1.0), -1050, 150)
285	    within = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionFrac, scaled, -1700, 380)
286	    not_gap = g.less(g.const(CELL_GAP, -1550, 480), within, -1400, 380)
287	    strip_on = g.mul(lit, not_gap, -850, 250)
288	    on = g.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionMax, strip_on, off_strip, -650, 300)
289	    glow = g.mul(element_color(g, -1200, 700), g.scalar("Glow", -1000, 820, STRIP_GLOW), -800, 700)
290	    emissive = g.mul(g.mul(mask, on, -500, 400, a_out="R"), glow, -300, 500)
291	    g.out(emissive, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
292	    finish(m, "M_RifleAtlas")
293	    return m
294	
295	
296	def build_indicator(textures):
297	    # The two sight lenses: same surface as the body; the neon mask glows only with Flash (weak-point hit).
298	    m = get_or_create_material("M_RifleIndicator")
299	    opaque(m)
300	    g = Graph(m)
301	    mask = surface(g, textures)
302	    glow = g.mul(element_color(g, -1200, 400), g.scalar("Glow", -1000, 520, INDICATOR_GLOW), -800, 400)
303	    flash = g.mul(glow, g.scalar("Flash", -800, 560, 0.0), -600, 450)
304	    g.out(g.mul(mask, flash, -300, 300, a_out="R"), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
305	    finish(m, "M_RifleIndicator")
306	    return m
307	
308	
309	def shared(name):
310	    path = SHARED_DIR + "/" + name
311	    asset = EAL.load_asset(path) if EAL.does_asset_exist(path) else None
312	    if not isinstance(asset, unreal.Material):
313	        fail("%s is missing: run Tools/Jam/Import-Pistol.ps1 first" % path)
314	    return asset
315	
316	
317	def make_instance(name, parent, params):
318	    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
319	    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
320	        mi = EAL.load_asset(path)
321	    else:
322	        mi = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
323	            name, MESH_DIR, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstant, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstantFactoryNew())
324	    if mi is None:
325	        fail("could not create %s" % path)
326	    MEL.set_material_instance_parent(mi, parent)
327	    for p, v in params.items():
328	        if isinstance(v, tuple):
329	            MEL.set_material_instance_vector_parameter_value(mi, p, unreal.LinearColor(v[0], v[1], v[2], 1.0))
330	        else:
331	            MEL.set_material_instance_scalar_parameter_value(mi, p, v)
332	    MEL.update_material_instance(mi)
333	    return mi
334	
335	
336	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- assign and check
337	
338	def imbue_uv_check(mesh):
339	    """UV channel 1 of the body must carry the strip coordinate: U across 0..1 on the strip, V 0 (strip) or 1."""
340	    description = mesh.get_static_mesh_description(0)
341	    count = description.get_vertex_instance_count()
342	    on_strip, off_strip, us = 0, 0, []
343	    for i in range(count):
344	        vid = unreal.VertexInstanceID()
345	        vid.set_editor_property("id_value", i)
346	        uv = description.get_vertex_instance_uv(vid, 1)
347	        if uv.y < 0.5:
348	            on_strip += 1
349	            us.append(uv.x)
350	        else:
351	            off_strip += 1
352	    log("body UV 1 over %d vertex instances: %d on the strip (U %.3f .. %.3f), %d off" % (
353	        count, on_strip, min(us) if us else -1, max(us) if us else -1, off_strip))
354	    if on_strip == 0 or off_strip == 0 or min(us) > 0.05 or max(us) < 0.95:
355	        fail("SM_Rifle_Body UV channel 1 does not carry the strip coordinate")
356	
357	
358	def assign(meshes, masters):
359	    instances = {}
360	    for blender_name, (parent_name, params) in SLOT_MATERIALS.items():
361	        if parent_name == SOLID:
362	            instances[key(blender_name)] = make_instance("MI_" + blender_name, masters[SOLID], params)
363	        else:
364	            instances[key(blender_name)] = masters[parent_name]
365	    for name, mesh in meshes.items():
366	        slots = mesh.get_editor_property("static_materials")
367	        for index, slot in enumerate(slots):
368	            slot_key = key(str(slot.material_slot_name))
369	            match = next((m for k, m in instances.items() if slot_key.startswith(k)), None)
370	            if match is None:
371	                fail("%s slot %d '%s' has no material in SLOT_MATERIALS" % (name, index, slot.material_slot_name))
372	            mesh.set_material(index, match)
373	        box = mesh.get_bounding_box()
374	        log("mesh %s slots=%d tris=%d bounds min=(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f) max=(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f)" % (
375	            name, len(slots), mesh.get_num_triangles(0),
376	            box.min.x, box.min.y, box.min.z, box.max.x, box.max.y, box.max.z))
377	    mag_slots = len(meshes["SM_Rifle_Magazine"].get_editor_property("static_materials"))
378	    if mag_slots != 3:
379	        fail("SM_Rifle_Magazine has %d material slots, expected 3 (body, plate, glow)" % mag_slots)
380	    imbue_uv_check(meshes["SM_Rifle_Body"])
381	
382	
383	def main():
384	    if not SOURCE_DIR or not os.path.isdir(SOURCE_DIR):
385	        fail("GB_RIFLE_STAGE is not set or missing; run Tools/Jam/Import-Rifle.ps1")
386	    if not EAL.does_directory_exist(MESH_DIR):
387	        EAL.make_directory(MESH_DIR)
388	    masters = {SOLID: shared(SOLID), "M_GunHolo": shared("M_GunHolo")}
389	    textures = import_textures()
390	    meshes = import_meshes()
391	    masters["M_RifleAtlas"] = build_atlas(textures)
392	    masters["M_RifleIndicator"] = build_indicator(textures)
393	    assign(meshes, masters)
394	    if not EAL.save_directory(MESH_DIR, only_if_is_dirty=False, recursive=True):
395	        fail("could not save %s" % MESH_DIR)
396	    log("OK")
397	
398	
399	main()

# import_rifle.py - Unreal Editor Python script that imports the assault rifle from SourceArt and builds its
# materials. Content/ is not in git, so this script plus Rifle.blend on CENTRAL are the source of the assets.
# Run it through Tools/Jam/Import-Rifle.ps1 (UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=pythonscript), Editor closed, pistol imported first.
#
# Inputs, in the temporary folder GB_RIFLE_STAGE (Tools/Blender/rifle_export_fbx.py):
#   Export/SM_Rifle_{Body,Trigger,Magazine,WeakPointLight,AmmoDisplay}.fbx
#   Textures/T_Rifle_{BaseColor,EmissiveMask}.png
# Output: /Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Rifle/. Parameters the game sets (same names as the pistol, AGBGun):
#   ElementColor   (vector) the glow colour (enchant element, or the rifle's own colour)
#   ImbueRemaining (scalar) M_RifleAtlas: the side neon strip is split into 13 cells along the gun (UV 1 U = 0 at the
#                  strip's muzzle end); a cell is lit while 1 - its centre U < ImbueRemaining, so the strip drains from
#                  the muzzle end towards the stock, like the pistol bar. Glow off the strip (UV 1 V = 1) stays lit.
#   Flash          (scalar) M_RifleIndicator: the two sight lenses, 0 = off, 1 = full glow (weak-point hit)
#   DisplayTexture (texture) M_GunHolo (shared with the pistol): the ammo count
import os
import re
import unreal

MESH_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Rifle"
SHARED_DIR = "/Game/Glyphbound/Weapons/Pistol"   # M_GunSolid and M_GunHolo, built by import_pistol.py
SOURCE_DIR = os.environ.get("GB_RIFLE_STAGE", "")
MESHES = ["SM_Rifle_Body", "SM_Rifle_Trigger", "SM_Rifle_Magazine", "SM_Rifle_WeakPointLight", "SM_Rifle_AmmoDisplay"]
STRIP_CELLS = 13
CELL_GAP = 0.12          # dark share at the start of each cell, so the strip reads as segments
STRIP_GLOW = 4.0         # emission strength of the neon in the element colour
INDICATOR_GLOW = 10.0
TEXTURES = {
    # name: (compression, sRGB)
    "T_Rifle_BaseColor": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_DEFAULT, True),
    "T_Rifle_EmissiveMask": (unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_MASKS, False),
}
MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE = 4096   # the Tripo maps at full size: at 2048 the parts nearest the camera looked blurry and soft
RIFLE_MINT = (0.05, 0.9, 0.6)
ALBEDO_SCALE = 0.8
ROUGH_POLYMER = 0.68
ROUGH_METAL = 0.36
METAL_DARK = 0.6

SOLID = "M_GunSolid"
SLOT_MATERIALS = {
    "carabina_roja": ("M_RifleAtlas", {}),
    "Rifle_WeakPoint": ("M_RifleIndicator", {}),
    "Holo_AmmoDisplay": ("M_GunHolo", {}),
    "Rifle_Mag_Body": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.035, 0.04, 0.045), "Metallic": 0.6, "Roughness": 0.35}),
    "Rifle_Mag_Plate": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.72, 0.74, 0.77), "Metallic": 0.1, "Roughness": 0.45}),
    "Rifle_Mag_Glow": (SOLID, {"BaseColor": (0.01, 0.01, 0.01), "Metallic": 0.0, "Roughness": 0.5, "Glow": 4.0}),
}

MEL = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary
EAL = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary


def log(message):
    unreal.log("import_rifle: " + message)


def fail(message):
    unreal.log_error("import_rifle: ERROR " + message)
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def key(name):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower())


def run_import(filename, options=None):
    task = unreal.AssetImportTask()
    task.filename = filename
    task.destination_path = MESH_DIR
    task.automated = True
    task.replace_existing = True
    task.save = False
    if options is not None:
        task.options = options
    unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().import_asset_tasks([task])
    paths = list(task.imported_object_paths)
    if not paths:
        fail("nothing imported from %s" % filename)
    return paths


def import_textures():
    textures = {}
    for name, (compression, srgb) in TEXTURES.items():
        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Textures", name + ".png")
        if not os.path.isfile(source):
            fail("missing %s" % source)
        run_import(source)
        texture = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
        if not isinstance(texture, unreal.Texture2D):
            fail("%s did not import as a Texture2D" % name)
        texture.set_editor_property("compression_settings", compression)
        texture.set_editor_property("srgb", srgb)
        texture.set_editor_property("lod_group", unreal.TextureGroup.TEXTUREGROUP_WEAPON)
        texture.set_editor_property("max_texture_size", MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE)
        # Always resident: streamed, the rifle showed its lowest mip (flat, blurry) for the first second after equip.
        texture.set_editor_property("never_stream", True)
        textures[name] = texture
        log("texture %s %s srgb=%s max=%d" % (name, compression, srgb, MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE))
    return textures


def fbx_options():
    ui = unreal.FbxImportUI()
    ui.set_editor_property("import_mesh", True)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_as_skeletal", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_materials", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_textures", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("import_animations", False)
    ui.set_editor_property("mesh_type_to_import", unreal.FBXImportType.FBXIT_STATIC_MESH)
    data = ui.static_mesh_import_data
    data.set_editor_property("combine_meshes", True)
    data.set_editor_property("auto_generate_collision", False)
    data.set_editor_property("generate_lightmap_u_vs", False)
    data.set_editor_property("remove_degenerates", False)
    data.set_editor_property("convert_scene", True)
    data.set_editor_property("force_front_x_axis", False)
    data.set_editor_property("import_uniform_scale", 1.0)
    data.set_editor_property("normal_import_method", unreal.FBXNormalImportMethod.FBXNIM_IMPORT_NORMALS)
    return ui


def import_meshes():
    unreal.SystemLibrary.execute_console_command(None, "Interchange.FeatureFlags.Import.FBX false")
    meshes = {}
    for name in MESHES:
        source = os.path.join(SOURCE_DIR, "Export", name + ".fbx")
        if not os.path.isfile(source):
            fail("missing %s (run Tools/Blender/rifle_export_fbx.py)" % source)
        run_import(source, fbx_options())
        mesh = unreal.load_asset(MESH_DIR + "/" + name)
        if not isinstance(mesh, unreal.StaticMesh):
            fail("%s did not import as a StaticMesh" % name)
        meshes[name] = mesh
    return meshes


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- materials

def get_or_create_material(name):
    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
        material = EAL.load_asset(path)
        if not isinstance(material, unreal.Material):
            fail("%s exists but is not a Material" % path)
        MEL.delete_all_material_expressions(material)
        return material
    material = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
        name, MESH_DIR, unreal.Material, unreal.MaterialFactoryNew())
    if material is None:
        fail("could not create %s" % path)
    return material


class Graph(object):
    def __init__(self, material):
        self.material = material

    def node(self, cls, x, y, **props):
        e = MEL.create_material_expression(self.material, cls, x, y)
        if e is None:
            fail("could not create %s" % cls.__name__)
        for k, v in props.items():
            e.set_editor_property(k, v)
        return e

    def connect(self, src, out, dst, inputs):
        if isinstance(inputs, str):
            inputs = [inputs]
        for i in inputs:
            if MEL.connect_material_expressions(src, out, dst, i):
                return
        fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s.%r (inputs %s)" % (
            src.get_class().get_name(), out, dst.get_class().get_name(), inputs,
            list(MEL.get_material_expression_input_names(dst))))

    def out(self, src, out, prop):
        if not MEL.connect_material_property(src, out, prop):
            fail("cannot connect %s.%r -> %s" % (src.get_class().get_name(), out, prop))

    def scalar(self, name, x, y, value):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionScalarParameter, x, y, parameter_name=name, default_value=value)

    def const(self, value, x, y):
        return self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant, x, y, r=value)

    def binary(self, cls, a, b, x, y, a_out="", b_out=""):
        m = self.node(cls, x, y)
        self.connect(a, a_out, m, "A")
        self.connect(b, b_out, m, "B")
        return m

    def mul(self, a, b, x, y, a_out="", b_out=""):
        return self.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionMultiply, a, b, x, y, a_out, b_out)

    def unary(self, cls, src, x, y, src_out=""):
        m = self.node(cls, x, y)
        self.connect(src, src_out, m, ["", "Input"])
        return m

    def less(self, a, b, x, y):
        """1 where a < b, else 0."""
        e = self.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionIf, x, y)
        self.connect(a, "", e, "A")
        self.connect(b, "", e, "B")
        zero, one = self.const(0.0, x - 150, y + 120), self.const(1.0, x - 150, y + 200)
        self.connect(zero, "", e, ["A > B", "AGreaterThanB"])
        self.connect(zero, "", e, ["A == B", "AEqualsB"])
        self.connect(one, "", e, ["A < B", "ALessThanB"])
        return e


def finish(material, name):
    errors = MEL.recompile_material(material)
    if errors:
        for e in errors:
            unreal.log_error("import_rifle: ERROR compile: %s" % e)
        fail("%s has compile errors" % name)
    bad = MEL.get_material_error_expressions(material)
    if bad:
        fail("%s: %d expressions report errors" % (name, len(bad)))
    log("material %s" % name)


def opaque(material):
    # One-sided on purpose: the Tripo body has panels doubled back to back; two-sided, they z-fight and the whole
    # rifle looks grainy (tried, seen in the smoke screenshot).
    material.set_editor_property("blend_mode", unreal.BlendMode.BLEND_OPAQUE)
    material.set_editor_property("shading_model", unreal.MaterialShadingModel.MSM_DEFAULT_LIT)
    material.set_editor_property("two_sided", False)


def surface(g, textures):
    """Albedo from the Tripo map; roughness and metallic derived from its brightness (no ORM). Returns the mask."""
    base = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, -1400, -600, texture=textures["T_Rifle_BaseColor"],
                  sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_COLOR)
    # The white polymer read washed out next to the pistol in the arena light: albedo x ALBEDO_SCALE.
    g.out(g.mul(base, g.const(ALBEDO_SCALE, -1200, -450), -900, -600, a_out="RGB"), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR)
    # No ORM in the source: the albedo's brightness tells polymer from metal. Light parts are matte white polymer
    # (roughness ROUGH_POLYMER, not metallic); dark parts are satin metal (ROUGH_METAL, metallic METAL_DARK). One flat
    # value for the whole gun made it read soft and glossy.
    lum = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionDotProduct, -1100, -380)
    g.connect(base, "RGB", lum, "A")
    g.connect(g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector, -1300, -300, constant=unreal.LinearColor(0.3, 0.59, 0.11, 1.0)), "", lum, "B")
    light = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionSaturate,
                    g.mul(g.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionSubtract, lum, g.const(0.1, -1000, -260), -900, -380),
                          g.const(1.0 / 0.3, -900, -260), -750, -380), -600, -380)
    rough = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionLinearInterpolate, -400, -380)
    g.connect(g.const(ROUGH_METAL, -550, -300), "", rough, "A")
    g.connect(g.const(ROUGH_POLYMER, -550, -240), "", rough, "B")
    g.connect(light, "", rough, "Alpha")
    g.out(rough, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS)
    metal = g.mul(g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionOneMinus, light, -450, -460), g.const(METAL_DARK, -450, -520), -300, -480)
    g.out(metal, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC)
    return g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample, -1400, -300, texture=textures["T_Rifle_EmissiveMask"],
                  sampler_type=unreal.MaterialSamplerType.SAMPLERTYPE_MASKS)


def element_color(g, x, y):
    v = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionVectorParameter, x, y, parameter_name="ElementColor",
               default_value=unreal.LinearColor(RIFLE_MINT[0], RIFLE_MINT[1], RIFLE_MINT[2], 1.0))
    m = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, x + 200, y, r=True, g=True, b=True, a=False)
    g.connect(v, "", m, ["", "Input"])
    return m


def build_atlas(textures):
    # Body: albedo, neon mask in the element colour; on the strip (UV 1 V = 0) only lit cells glow, with thin gaps.
    m = get_or_create_material("M_RifleAtlas")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    mask = surface(g, textures)
    uv = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureCoordinate, -2400, 200, coordinate_index=1)
    u_raw = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -2200, 200, r=True, g=False, b=False, a=False)
    g.connect(uv, "", u_raw, ["", "Input"])
    off_strip = g.node(unreal.MaterialExpressionComponentMask, -2200, 500, r=False, g=True, b=False, a=False)
    g.connect(uv, "", off_strip, ["", "Input"])
    u = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionSaturate, u_raw, -2000, 200)
    scaled = g.mul(u, g.const(float(STRIP_CELLS) * 0.99999, -2000, 320), -1850, 200)
    cell = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionFloor, scaled, -1700, 150)
    centre = g.mul(g.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionAdd, cell, g.const(0.5, -1700, 260), -1550, 150),
                   g.const(1.0 / STRIP_CELLS, -1550, 260), -1400, 150)
    from_muzzle = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionOneMinus, centre, -1250, 150)
    lit = g.less(from_muzzle, g.scalar("ImbueRemaining", -1250, 260, 1.0), -1050, 150)
    within = g.unary(unreal.MaterialExpressionFrac, scaled, -1700, 380)
    not_gap = g.less(g.const(CELL_GAP, -1550, 480), within, -1400, 380)
    strip_on = g.mul(lit, not_gap, -850, 250)
    on = g.binary(unreal.MaterialExpressionMax, strip_on, off_strip, -650, 300)
    glow = g.mul(element_color(g, -1200, 700), g.scalar("Glow", -1000, 820, STRIP_GLOW), -800, 700)
    emissive = g.mul(g.mul(mask, on, -500, 400, a_out="R"), glow, -300, 500)
    g.out(emissive, "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, "M_RifleAtlas")
    return m


def build_indicator(textures):
    # The two sight lenses: same surface as the body; the neon mask glows only with Flash (weak-point hit).
    m = get_or_create_material("M_RifleIndicator")
    opaque(m)
    g = Graph(m)
    mask = surface(g, textures)
    glow = g.mul(element_color(g, -1200, 400), g.scalar("Glow", -1000, 520, INDICATOR_GLOW), -800, 400)
    flash = g.mul(glow, g.scalar("Flash", -800, 560, 0.0), -600, 450)
    g.out(g.mul(mask, flash, -300, 300, a_out="R"), "", unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR)
    finish(m, "M_RifleIndicator")
    return m


def shared(name):
    path = SHARED_DIR + "/" + name
    asset = EAL.load_asset(path) if EAL.does_asset_exist(path) else None
    if not isinstance(asset, unreal.Material):
        fail("%s is missing: run Tools/Jam/Import-Pistol.ps1 first" % path)
    return asset


def make_instance(name, parent, params):
    path = MESH_DIR + "/" + name
    if EAL.does_asset_exist(path):
        mi = EAL.load_asset(path)
    else:
        mi = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools().create_asset(
            name, MESH_DIR, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstant, unreal.MaterialInstanceConstantFactoryNew())
    if mi is None:
        fail("could not create %s" % path)
    MEL.set_material_instance_parent(mi, parent)
    for p, v in params.items():
        if isinstance(v, tuple):
            MEL.set_material_instance_vector_parameter_value(mi, p, unreal.LinearColor(v[0], v[1], v[2], 1.0))
        else:
            MEL.set_material_instance_scalar_parameter_value(mi, p, v)

def imbue_uv_check(mesh):
    """UV channel 1 of the body must carry the strip coordinate: U across 0..1 on the strip, V 0 (strip) or 1."""
    description = mesh.get_static_mesh_description(0)
    count = description.get_vertex_instance_count()
    on_strip, off_strip, us = 0, 0, []
    for i in range(count):
        vid = unreal.VertexInstanceID()
        vid.set_editor_property("id_value", i)
        uv = description.get_vertex_instance_uv(vid, 1)
        if uv.y < 0.5:
            on_strip += 1
            us.append(uv.x)
        else:
            off_strip += 1
    log("body UV 1 over %d vertex instances: %d on the strip (U %.3f .. %.3f), %d off" % (
        count, on_strip, min(us) if us else -1, max(us) if us else -1, off_strip))
    if on_strip == 0 or off_strip == 0 or min(us) > 0.05 or max(us) < 0.95:

    instances = {}
    for blender_name, (parent_name, params) in SLOT_MATERIALS.items():
        if parent_name == SOLID:
            instances[key(blender_name)] = make_instance("MI_" + blender_name, masters[SOLID], params)
        else:
            instances[key(blender_name)] = masters[parent_name]
    for name, mesh in meshes.items():
        slots = mesh.get_editor_property("static_materials")
        for index, slot in enumerate(slots):
            slot_key = key(str(slot.material_slot_name))
            match = next((m for k, m in instances.items() if slot_key.startswith(k)), None)
            if match is None:
                fail("%s slot %d '%s' has no material in SLOT_MATERIALS" % (name, index, slot.material_slot_name))

            name, len(slots), mesh.get_num_triangles(0),

        EAL.make_directory(MESH_DIR)
    masters = {SOLID: shared(SOLID), "M_GunHolo": shared("M_GunHolo")}

    meshes = import_meshes()
    masters["M_RifleAtlas"] = build_atlas(textures)
    masters["M_RifleIndicator"] = build_indicator(textures)
    assign(meshes, masters)
    if not EAL.save_directory(MESH_DIR, only_if_is_dirty=False, recursive=True):
        fail("could not save %s" % MESH_DIR)
    log("OK")

# Review renders of the rifle in its source frame (muzzle -Y, up +Z, metres): first-person and close-ups, Cycles.
# Usage: blender -b --factory-startup --python render_review.py -- <file.glb|file.blend> <out_dir> [prefix] [dump_textures]
import bpy, sys, os, math
from mathutils import Vector

argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
path, out_dir = argv[0], argv[1]
prefix = argv[2] if len(argv) > 2 else "v"
dump = len(argv) > 3 and argv[3] == "1"
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
if path.lower().endswith(".blend"):
    bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=path)
else:
    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
    bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=path)

sc = bpy.context.scene
sc.render.engine = "CYCLES"
prefs = bpy.context.preferences.addons["cycles"].preferences
for kind in ("OPTIX", "CUDA"):
    try:
        prefs.compute_device_type = kind
        prefs.get_devices()
        for d in prefs.devices:
            d.use = True
        sc.cycles.device = "GPU"
        break
    except Exception as e:
        print("no", kind, e)
sc.cycles.samples = 96
sc.cycles.use_denoising = True
sc.render.resolution_x, sc.render.resolution_y = 1920, 1080
sc.view_settings.view_transform = "AgX"

world = bpy.data.worlds.new("ReviewWorld")
world.use_nodes = True
bg = world.node_tree.nodes.get("Background")
bg.inputs[0].default_value = (0.20, 0.22, 0.26, 1)
bg.inputs[1].default_value = 1.0
sc.world = world
for ob in list(bpy.data.objects):
    if ob.type in ("LIGHT", "CAMERA"):
        ob.hide_render = True


def add_light(name, kind, rot, energy, size=0.0, loc=(0, 0, 0)):
    ld = bpy.data.lights.new(name, kind)
    ld.energy = energy
    if kind == "SUN":
        ld.angle = math.radians(3)
    else:
        ld.size = size
    lo = bpy.data.objects.new(name, ld)
    lo.rotation_euler = [math.radians(a) for a in rot]
    lo.location = loc
    sc.collection.objects.link(lo)


add_light("Key", "SUN", (48, 0, 150), 3.5)          # from above, behind-left of the shooter
add_light("Fill", "SUN", (65, 0, -60), 0.8)

cam_data = bpy.data.cameras.new("ReviewCam")
cam_data.clip_start = 0.01
cam = bpy.data.objects.new("ReviewCam", cam_data)
sc.collection.objects.link(cam)
sc.camera = cam


def shoot(name, loc, target, lens):
    cam.location = Vector(loc)
    cam.rotation_euler = (Vector(target) - cam.location).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
    cam_data.lens = lens
    sc.render.filepath = os.path.join(out_dir, "%s_%s.png" % (prefix, name))
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
    print("RENDER", sc.render.filepath)


# Shooter looks to -Y; the shooter's right is -X. Hand point (grip top) is about (-0.0055, 0.19, 0).
# First person: eye 9 cm left of the gun, 13 cm above the grip top, 20 cm behind it; 90 deg horizontal FOV (18 mm).
shoot("fp", (0.085, 0.42, 0.14), (0.085, -1.0, 0.11), 18)
shoot("fp_close", (0.10, 0.33, 0.16), (-0.01, -0.05, 0.05), 35)
shoot("left_side", (0.75, 0.0, 0.12), (0.0, 0.0, 0.0), 50)
shoot("left_receiver", (0.32, 0.22, 0.10), (0.0, 0.08, 0.03), 50)
shoot("left_front", (0.30, -0.10, 0.12), (0.0, -0.25, 0.03), 50)
shoot("right_side", (-0.75, 0.0, 0.12), (0.0, 0.0, 0.0), 50)

if dump:
    for im in bpy.data.images:
        if im.size[0] > 0 and im.name not in ("Render Result", "Viewer Node"):
            c = im.copy()
            c.scale(2048, 2048)
            name = "tex_" + ("color" if im.name.startswith("Color_") else im.name)
            c.filepath_raw = os.path.join(out_dir, name + ".png")
            c.file_format = "PNG"
            c.save()
            print("TEX", c.filepath_raw)

1	# Removes inherited marks (text, digits, QR-like patterns) and earlier flat patches from the pistol atlas.
2	# Method: seamless (Poisson-style) cloning. For each region a donor block of the same size is chosen nearby by
3	# matching the ring of pixels around it; the donor is pasted and a harmonic membrane corrects it so the edges
4	# match the surroundings. The same donor offset is used for Color, ORM and NormalGL so albedo, roughness/metal
5	# and relief stay consistent. Regions flagged "fill" use only the harmonic fill (smooth, no donor), used inside
6	# the glowing cyan label where any donor would bring a different pattern.
7	#
8	# Usage: blender -b <in.blend> --python pistol_clean_atlas.py -- <out.blend> <review_dir>
9	import bpy, sys, os
10	import numpy as np
11	
12	argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
13	out_blend, review_dir = argv[0], argv[1]
14	os.makedirs(review_dir, exist_ok=True)
15	
16	# (name, x0, y0, x1, y1, mode) in atlas pixels, origin TOP-LEFT, x1/y1 exclusive.
17	REGIONS = [
18	    # a symbol that exists only in the ORM roughness channel (seen as a smudge on the +Y silver panel); first, so
19	    # no later region can use it as a donor
20	    ("orm_symbol",       1088, 1210, 1134, 1296, "clone"),
21	    ("v4_matrix_patch",   518,  894,  610,  994, "clone"),
22	    ("v4_drawing_patch", 1194, 1068, 1310, 1158, "clone"),
23	    ("old_flat_patch_a",  238,  950,  324, 1017, "clone"),
24	    ("symbol_label",      282,  978,  352, 1044, "clone"),
25	    ("tiny_text",         156,  938,  174,  948, "clone"),
26	    ("old_flat_patch_b",  860,  826,  968,  902, "grain"),
27	    ("edge_text_left",      0,  316,   15,  404, "clone"),
28	    ("qr_like_block",     148,  296,  180,  332, "clone"),
29	    ("vertical_text",    1739, 1564, 1753, 1638, "clone"),
30	    ("cyan_label_digits", 305,  425,  345,  500, "fill"),
31	    # rear face (the one the player sees): thin dotted columns that stretched faces blow up into text-like smears,
32	    # and an engraved dotted arc under the dial
33	    ("rear_column_a",    1194, 1232, 1204, 1334, "fill"),
34	    ("rear_column_b",    1221, 1278, 1228, 1338, "fill"),
35	    ("rear_top_column",  1240, 1915, 1252, 1996, "fill"),
36	    ("dial_arc",          638,  846,  704,  866, "fill"),
37	]
38	RING = 3          # px of surroundings compared when choosing a donor
39	SEARCH = 260      # px search radius for the donor
40	STEP = 2
41	GRAIN_RADIUS = 6   # box-blur radius whose residual is the "grain" used by mode "grain"
42	
43	def box_blur(a, r):
44	    """Mean over a (2r+1)^2 window, edges clamped. a: (h, w, c)."""
45	    p = np.pad(a, ((r + 1, r), (r + 1, r), (0, 0)), mode="edge")
46	    s = p.cumsum(0).cumsum(1)
47	    k = 2 * r + 1
48	    return (s[k:, k:] - s[:-k, k:] - s[k:, :-k] + s[:-k, :-k]) / (k * k)
49	
50	def load(prefix):
51	    im = next(i for i in bpy.data.images if i.name.startswith(prefix))
52	    w, h = im.size
53	    a = np.array(im.pixels[:], dtype=np.float32).reshape(h, w, 4)[::-1].copy()
54	    return im, a
55	
56	def store(im, a):
57	    im.pixels.foreach_set(np.ascontiguousarray(a[::-1]).ravel())
58	    im.update()
59	    im.pack()
60	
61	def overlaps(x0, y0, x1, y1, margin):
62	    for _, a0, b0, a1, b1, _ in REGIONS:
63	        if x0 < a1 + margin and x1 > a0 - margin and y0 < b1 + margin and y1 > b0 - margin:
64	            return True
65	    return False
66	
67	def ring_mask(h, w):
68	    m = np.ones((h + 2 * RING, w + 2 * RING), bool)
69	    m[RING:-RING, RING:-RING] = False
70	    return m
71	
72	def membrane(boundary_img, h, w, iters=2500):
73	    """Harmonic interpolation inside an h x w box whose 1-px outer frame is given by boundary_img ((h+2) x (w+2) x C)."""
74	    u = boundary_img.copy()
75	    # Coons-patch initial guess (bilinear blend of the four edges) speeds convergence.
76	    top, bot = u[0:1, 1:-1], u[-1:, 1:-1]
77	    lef, rig = u[1:-1, 0:1], u[1:-1, -1:]
78	    ty = np.linspace(0, 1, h + 2)[1:-1, None, None]
79	    tx = np.linspace(0, 1, w + 2)[None, 1:-1, None]
80	    guess = (1 - ty) * top + ty * bot + (1 - tx) * lef + tx * rig
81	    corners = ((1 - ty) * (1 - tx) * u[0, 0] + (1 - ty) * tx * u[0, -1] + ty * (1 - tx) * u[-1, 0] + ty * tx * u[-1, -1])
82	    u[1:-1, 1:-1] = guess - corners
83	    for _ in range(iters):
84	        u[1:-1, 1:-1] = 0.25 * (u[:-2, 1:-1] + u[2:, 1:-1] + u[1:-1, :-2] + u[1:-1, 2:])
85	    return u[1:-1, 1:-1]
86	
87	im_c, C = load("Color_")
88	im_o, O = load("ORM_")
89	im_n, N = load("NormalGL_")
90	H, W = C.shape[:2]
91	mask_ring = None
92	log = []
93	
94	for name, x0, y0, x1, y1, mode in REGIONS:
95	    h, w = y1 - y0, x1 - x0
96	    # frame = 1px ring just outside the region, clamped to the image
97	    fy0, fy1, fx0, fx1 = max(y0 - 1, 0), min(y1 + 1, H), max(x0 - 1, 0), min(x1 + 1, W)
98	    if mode in ("clone", "grain"):
99	        rm = ring_mask(h, w)
100	        ry0, rx0 = y0 - RING, x0 - RING
101	        def ring_pixels(img, oy, ox):
102	            sy0, sx0 = ry0 + oy, rx0 + ox
103	            blk = img[max(sy0, 0):sy0 + h + 2 * RING, max(sx0, 0):sx0 + w + 2 * RING]
104	            return blk
105	        CO = np.concatenate([C[..., :3], O[..., :3]], axis=2)  # match the ring in Color and ORM together
106	        tgt = ring_pixels(CO, 0, 0)
107	        valid = None
108	        if tgt.shape[:2] != rm.shape:  # region touches the border: compare only the part inside
109	            valid = np.zeros_like(rm)
110	            valid[:tgt.shape[0], :tgt.shape[1]] = True
111	        best = None
112	        for oy in range(-SEARCH, SEARCH + 1, STEP):
113	            for ox in range(-SEARCH, SEARCH + 1, STEP):
114	                if abs(oy) < h + 2 and abs(ox) < w + 2:
115	                    continue
116	                dy0, dx0, dy1, dx1 = y0 + oy, x0 + ox, y1 + oy, x1 + ox
117	                if dy0 - RING < 0 or dx0 - RING < 0 or dy1 + RING > H or dx1 + RING > W:
118	                    continue
119	                if overlaps(dx0, dy0, dx1, dy1, RING + 2):
120	                    continue
121	                d = CO[dy0 - RING:dy1 + RING, dx0 - RING:dx1 + RING]
122	                if valid is not None:
123	                    d = d[:tgt.shape[0], :tgt.shape[1]]
124	                    m = rm[:tgt.shape[0], :tgt.shape[1]]
125	                else:
126	                    m = rm
127	                if mode == "clone":
128	                    score = float(((d[m] - tgt[m]) ** 2).mean())
129	                else:
130	                    # "grain": only the donor's fine texture is used, so pick the smoothest block (largest local
131	                    # step small) whose mean brightness matches the surroundings.
132	                    lum = C[dy0:dy1, dx0:dx1, :3].mean(axis=2)
133	                    steps = max(float(np.abs(np.diff(lum, axis=0)).max()), float(np.abs(np.diff(lum, axis=1)).max()))
134	                    score = steps + abs(float(lum.mean()) - float(tgt[m][:, :3].mean()))
135	                if best is None or score < best[0]:
136	                    best = (score, oy, ox)
137	        score, oy, ox = best
138	        log.append(f"{name}: {mode} from offset dy={oy} dx={ox} ring_mse={score:.5f}")
139	    else:
140	        oy = ox = 0
141	        log.append(f"{name}: harmonic fill")
142	
143	    for img, is_normal in ((C, False), (O, False), (N, True)):
144	        frame = img[fy0:fy1, fx0:fx1, :3].copy()
145	        # pad the frame to (h+2, w+2) when the region touches the image border
146	        frame = np.pad(frame, ((1 if y0 - 1 < 0 else 0, 1 if y1 + 1 > H else 0),
147	                               (1 if x0 - 1 < 0 else 0, 1 if x1 + 1 > W else 0), (0, 0)), mode="edge")
148	        if mode == "clone":
149	            donor = img[y0 + oy - 1:y1 + oy + 1, x0 + ox - 1:x1 + ox + 1, :3].copy()
150	            diff = frame - donor
151	            diff[1:-1, 1:-1] = 0
152	            corr = membrane(diff, h, w)
153	            new = donor[1:-1, 1:-1] + corr
154	        elif mode == "grain":
155	            # smooth fill from the surroundings plus soft isotropic noise whose strength matches the fine grain
156	            # measured in a 12 px band around the region (no donor shapes or streaks)
157	            B = 12
158	            band = img[max(y0 - B, 0):y1 + B, max(x0 - B, 0):x1 + B, :3]
159	            hp_band = band - box_blur(band, GRAIN_RADIUS)
160	            inner = np.ones(band.shape[:2], bool)
161	            inner[min(B, y0):min(B, y0) + h, min(B, x0):min(B, x0) + w] = False
162	            # robust (median-based) so UV-island edges in the band do not inflate it; one value for all channels
163	            sigma = np.full(3, 0.35 * 1.4826 * float(np.median(np.abs(hp_band[inner]))), np.float32)
164	            rng = np.random.default_rng(1234 + x0 * 7 + y0)
165	            noise = box_blur(rng.standard_normal((h, w, 1)).astype(np.float32), 1)
166	            noise /= max(float(noise.std()), 1e-6)
167	            new = membrane(frame, h, w) + noise * sigma[None, None, :]
168	        else:
169	            new = membrane(frame, h, w)
170	        if is_normal:
171	            v = new * 2 - 1
172	            v /= np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(v, axis=2, keepdims=True), 1e-6)
173	            new = v * 0.5 + 0.5
174	        img[y0:y1, x0:x1, :3] = np.clip(new, 0, 1)
175	
176	store(im_c, C)
177	store(im_o, O)
178	store(im_n, N)
179	
180	# Review images: each region with context, before/after is produced by running atlas_crop on both files.
181	for img, tag in ((C, "Color"), (O, "ORM"), (N, "NormalGL")):
182	    out = bpy.data.images.new("review_" + tag, W, H, alpha=True)
183	    out.colorspace_settings.name = "sRGB" if tag == "Color" else "Non-Color"
184	    out.pixels.foreach_set(np.ascontiguousarray(img[::-1]).ravel())
185	    out.filepath_raw = os.path.join(review_dir, f"{tag}_clean.png")
186	    out.file_format = "PNG"
187	    out.save()

# Removes inherited marks (text, digits, QR-like patterns) and earlier flat patches from the pistol atlas.
# Method: seamless (Poisson-style) cloning. For each region a donor block of the same size is chosen nearby by
# matching the ring of pixels around it; the donor is pasted and a harmonic membrane corrects it so the edges
# match the surroundings. The same donor offset is used for Color, ORM and NormalGL so albedo, roughness/metal
# and relief stay consistent. Regions flagged "fill" use only the harmonic fill (smooth, no donor), used inside
# the glowing cyan label where any donor would bring a different pattern.
#
# Usage: blender -b <in.blend> --python pistol_clean_atlas.py -- <out.blend> <review_dir>
import bpy, sys, os
import numpy as np

argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
out_blend, review_dir = argv[0], argv[1]
os.makedirs(review_dir, exist_ok=True)

# (name, x0, y0, x1, y1, mode) in atlas pixels, origin TOP-LEFT, x1/y1 exclusive.
REGIONS = [
    # a symbol that exists only in the ORM roughness channel (seen as a smudge on the +Y silver panel); first, so
    # no later region can use it as a donor
    ("orm_symbol",       1088, 1210, 1134, 1296, "clone"),
    ("v4_matrix_patch",   518,  894,  610,  994, "clone"),
    ("v4_drawing_patch", 1194, 1068, 1310, 1158, "clone"),
    ("old_flat_patch_a",  238,  950,  324, 1017, "clone"),
    ("symbol_label",      282,  978,  352, 1044, "clone"),
    ("tiny_text",         156,  938,  174,  948, "clone"),
    ("old_flat_patch_b",  860,  826,  968,  902, "grain"),
    ("edge_text_left",      0,  316,   15,  404, "clone"),
    ("qr_like_block",     148,  296,  180,  332, "clone"),
    ("vertical_text",    1739, 1564, 1753, 1638, "clone"),
    ("cyan_label_digits", 305,  425,  345,  500, "fill"),
    # rear face (the one the player sees): thin dotted columns that stretched faces blow up into text-like smears,
    # and an engraved dotted arc under the dial
    ("rear_column_a",    1194, 1232, 1204, 1334, "fill"),
    ("rear_column_b",    1221, 1278, 1228, 1338, "fill"),
    ("rear_top_column",  1240, 1915, 1252, 1996, "fill"),
    ("dial_arc",          638,  846,  704,  866, "fill"),
]
RING = 3          # px of surroundings compared when choosing a donor
SEARCH = 260      # px search radius for the donor
STEP = 2
GRAIN_RADIUS = 6   # box-blur radius whose residual is the "grain" used by mode "grain"

def box_blur(a, r):
    """Mean over a (2r+1)^2 window, edges clamped. a: (h, w, c)."""
    p = np.pad(a, ((r + 1, r), (r + 1, r), (0, 0)), mode="edge")
    s = p.cumsum(0).cumsum(1)
    k = 2 * r + 1
    return (s[k:, k:] - s[:-k, k:] - s[k:, :-k] + s[:-k, :-k]) / (k * k)

def load(prefix):
    im = next(i for i in bpy.data.images if i.name.startswith(prefix))
    w, h = im.size
    a = np.array(im.pixels[:], dtype=np.float32).reshape(h, w, 4)[::-1].copy()
    return im, a

def store(im, a):
    im.pixels.foreach_set(np.ascontiguousarray(a[::-1]).ravel())
    im.update()
    im.pack()

def overlaps(x0, y0, x1, y1, margin):
    for _, a0, b0, a1, b1, _ in REGIONS:
        if x0 < a1 + margin and x1 > a0 - margin and y0 < b1 + margin and y1 > b0 - margin:
            return True
    return False

def ring_mask(h, w):
    m = np.ones((h + 2 * RING, w + 2 * RING), bool)
    m[RING:-RING, RING:-RING] = False
    return m

def membrane(boundary_img, h, w, iters=2500):
    """Harmonic interpolation inside an h x w box whose 1-px outer frame is given by boundary_img ((h+2) x (w+2) x C)."""
    u = boundary_img.copy()
    # Coons-patch initial guess (bilinear blend of the four edges) speeds convergence.
    top, bot = u[0:1, 1:-1], u[-1:, 1:-1]
    lef, rig = u[1:-1, 0:1], u[1:-1, -1:]
    ty = np.linspace(0, 1, h + 2)[1:-1, None, None]
    tx = np.linspace(0, 1, w + 2)[None, 1:-1, None]
    guess = (1 - ty) * top + ty * bot + (1 - tx) * lef + tx * rig
    corners = ((1 - ty) * (1 - tx) * u[0, 0] + (1 - ty) * tx * u[0, -1] + ty * (1 - tx) * u[-1, 0] + ty * tx * u[-1, -1])
    u[1:-1, 1:-1] = guess - corners
    for _ in range(iters):
        u[1:-1, 1:-1] = 0.25 * (u[:-2, 1:-1] + u[2:, 1:-1] + u[1:-1, :-2] + u[1:-1, 2:])
    return u[1:-1, 1:-1]

im_c, C = load("Color_")
im_o, O = load("ORM_")
im_n, N = load("NormalGL_")
H, W = C.shape[:2]
mask_ring = None
log = []

for name, x0, y0, x1, y1, mode in REGIONS:
    h, w = y1 - y0, x1 - x0
    # frame = 1px ring just outside the region, clamped to the image
    fy0, fy1, fx0, fx1 = max(y0 - 1, 0), min(y1 + 1, H), max(x0 - 1, 0), min(x1 + 1, W)
    if mode in ("clone", "grain"):
        rm = ring_mask(h, w)
        ry0, rx0 = y0 - RING, x0 - RING
        def ring_pixels(img, oy, ox):
            sy0, sx0 = ry0 + oy, rx0 + ox
            blk = img[max(sy0, 0):sy0 + h + 2 * RING, max(sx0, 0):sx0 + w + 2 * RING]
            return blk
        CO = np.concatenate([C[..., :3], O[..., :3]], axis=2)  # match the ring in Color and ORM together
        tgt = ring_pixels(CO, 0, 0)
        valid = None
        if tgt.shape[:2] != rm.shape:  # region touches the border: compare only the part inside
            valid = np.zeros_like(rm)
            valid[:tgt.shape[0], :tgt.shape[1]] = True
        best = None
        for oy in range(-SEARCH, SEARCH + 1, STEP):
            for ox in range(-SEARCH, SEARCH + 1, STEP):
                if abs(oy) < h + 2 and abs(ox) < w + 2:
                    continue
                dy0, dx0, dy1, dx1 = y0 + oy, x0 + ox, y1 + oy, x1 + ox
                if dy0 - RING < 0 or dx0 - RING < 0 or dy1 + RING > H or dx1 + RING > W:
                    continue
                if overlaps(dx0, dy0, dx1, dy1, RING + 2):
                    continue
                d = CO[dy0 - RING:dy1 + RING, dx0 - RING:dx1 + RING]
                if valid is not None:
                    d = d[:tgt.shape[0], :tgt.shape[1]]
                    m = rm[:tgt.shape[0], :tgt.shape[1]]
                else:
                    m = rm
                if mode == "clone":
                    score = float(((d[m] - tgt[m]) ** 2).mean())
                else:
                    # "grain": only the donor's fine texture is used, so pick the smoothest block (largest local
                    # step small) whose mean brightness matches the surroundings.
                    lum = C[dy0:dy1, dx0:dx1, :3].mean(axis=2)
                    steps = max(float(np.abs(np.diff(lum, axis=0)).max()), float(np.abs(np.diff(lum, axis=1)).max()))
                    score = steps + abs(float(lum.mean()) - float(tgt[m][:, :3].mean()))
                if best is None or score < best[0]:
                    best = (score, oy, ox)
        score, oy, ox = best
        log.append(f"{name}: {mode} from offset dy={oy} dx={ox} ring_mse={score:.5f}")
    else:
        oy = ox = 0
        log.append(f"{name}: harmonic fill")

    for img, is_normal in ((C, False), (O, False), (N, True)):
        frame = img[fy0:fy1, fx0:fx1, :3].copy()
        # pad the frame to (h+2, w+2) when the region touches the image border
        frame = np.pad(frame, ((1 if y0 - 1 < 0 else 0, 1 if y1 + 1 > H else 0),
                               (1 if x0 - 1 < 0 else 0, 1 if x1 + 1 > W else 0), (0, 0)), mode="edge")
        if mode == "clone":
            donor = img[y0 + oy - 1:y1 + oy + 1, x0 + ox - 1:x1 + ox + 1, :3].copy()
            diff = frame - donor
            diff[1:-1, 1:-1] = 0
            corr = membrane(diff, h, w)
            new = donor[1:-1, 1:-1] + corr
        elif mode == "grain":
            # smooth fill from the surroundings plus soft isotropic noise whose strength matches the fine grain
            # measured in a 12 px band around the region (no donor shapes or streaks)
            B = 12
            band = img[max(y0 - B, 0):y1 + B, max(x0 - B, 0):x1 + B, :3]
            hp_band = band - box_blur(band, GRAIN_RADIUS)
            inner = np.ones(band.shape[:2], bool)
            inner[min(B, y0):min(B, y0) + h, min(B, x0):min(B, x0) + w] = False
            # robust (median-based) so UV-island edges in the band do not inflate it; one value for all channels
            sigma = np.full(3, 0.35 * 1.4826 * float(np.median(np.abs(hp_band[inner]))), np.float32)
            rng = np.random.default_rng(1234 + x0 * 7 + y0)
            noise = box_blur(rng.standard_normal((h, w, 1)).astype(np.float32), 1)
            noise /= max(float(noise.std()), 1e-6)
            new = membrane(frame, h, w) + noise * sigma[None, None, :]
        else:
            new = membrane(frame, h, w)
        if is_normal:
            v = new * 2 - 1
            v /= np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(v, axis=2, keepdims=True), 1e-6)
            new = v * 0.5 + 0.5
        img[y0:y1, x0:x1, :3] = np.clip(new, 0, 1)

store(im_c, C)
store(im_o, O)
store(im_n, N)

# Review images: each region with context, before/after is produced by running atlas_crop on both files.
for img, tag in ((C, "Color"), (O, "ORM"), (N, "NormalGL")):
    out = bpy.data.images.new("review_" + tag, W, H, alpha=True)
    out.colorspace_settings.name = "sRGB" if tag == "Color" else "Non-Color"
    out.pixels.foreach_set(np.ascontiguousarray(img[::-1]).ravel())
    out.filepath_raw = os.path.join(review_dir, f"{tag}_clean.png")
    out.file_format = "PNG"
    out.save()

bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=out_blend, compress=True)
with open(os.path.join(review_dir, "clean_log.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(log))
print("\n".join(log))
print("SAVED", out_blend)

# Builds the assault rifle's one source .blend from the owner's Tripo GLB (carabina-roja.zip, model.glb).
# The GLB is a 5.5k-triangle low-poly export with one 4096 albedo that carries baked light, smears and soft edges, and
# no roughness, metallic, normal or AO. Shown as it comes it reads soft ("made of jelly", owner). This script rebuilds
# the look on the same shape:
#   geometry  vertices welded (the GLB is split into ~1000 loose panels), Tripo's lumpy custom normals dropped, hard
#             edges above SHARP_ANGLE, face-area weighted normals so the large flat panels shade flat
#   BaseColor one flat tone per panel (the panel's median brightness snapped to a small palette), plus the small drawn
#             details (holes, panel lines) re-cut with crisp edges; baked light and smears are gone
#   ORM       R = ambient occlusion baked in Cycles, G = roughness and B = metallic by tone (white and grey polymer,
#             dark metal)
#   Normal    baked in Cycles (OpenGL, +Y): rounded edges (Bevel node) and the drawn details pressed in (Bump)
#   Emissive  the GLB's neon mask, edges re-cut
# Objects saved: Rifle_Body, Rifle_Trigger, Rifle_Lens (source frame: muzzle -Y, up +Z, metres).
# Usage: blender -b --factory-startup --python rifle_build_blend.py -- <model.glb> <out.blend> [review_dir]
import bpy, bmesh, sys, os, math
import numpy as np

argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
glb, out_blend = argv[0], argv[1]
review_dir = argv[2] if len(argv) > 2 else None

SHARP_ANGLE = 30.0
BEVEL_RADIUS = 0.0009      # metres: rounded-edge width baked into the normal map
DETAIL_DEPTH = 0.0005      # metres: how deep the drawn holes and panel lines are pressed in
AO_DISTANCE = 0.06
BAKE_SIZE = 4096
PAD = 24                   # texels of padding around every UV island

# Tone palette: (upper limit of the panel's median brightness, albedo sRGB, roughness, metallic)
TONES = [
    (0.24, (0.150, 0.155, 0.165), 0.42, 0.75),   # dark metal: barrel, rail, lower handguard
    (0.42, (0.300, 0.305, 0.315), 0.72, 0.0),    # mid grey: grip, stock pad, sight housing (rubbery polymer)
    (0.62, (0.520, 0.525, 0.535), 0.62, 0.0),    # light grey polymer
    (9.99, (0.790, 0.800, 0.815), 0.55, 0.0),    # white polymer shell
]
DARK_DETAIL = ((0.060, 0.062, 0.066), 0.80, 0.0)
LIGHT_DETAIL = ((0.600, 0.605, 0.615), 0.60, 0.0)
NEON_BASE = ((0.030, 0.030, 0.030), 0.30, 0.0)

bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=glb)
scene = bpy.context.scene
SRC = [o for o in scene.objects if o.type == "MESH"][0]
me = SRC.data
color_im = next(i for i in bpy.data.images if i.name.startswith("Color_"))
neon_im = bpy.data.images["neon_mask"]


def load(im):
    w, h = im.size
    a = np.empty(w * h * 4, np.float32)
    im.pixels.foreach_get(a)
    return a.reshape(h, w, 4)


def new_image(name, rgb, srgb):
    h, w = rgb.shape[:2]
    im = bpy.data.images.get(name) or bpy.data.images.new(name, w, h, alpha=False)
    im.colorspace_settings.name = "sRGB" if srgb else "Non-Color"
    a = np.ones((h, w, 4), np.float32)
    a[..., :rgb.shape[2]] = rgb if rgb.ndim == 3 else rgb[..., None]
    im.pixels.foreach_set(np.ascontiguousarray(a).ravel())
    im.update()
    im.pack()
    return im


def smoothstep(e0, e1, x):
    t = np.clip((x - e0) / (e1 - e0), 0.0, 1.0)
    return t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)


def box_blur(a, r):
    p = np.pad(a, ((r + 1, r), (r + 1, r)), mode="edge").astype(np.float64)
    s = p.cumsum(0).cumsum(1)
    k = 2 * r + 1
    return ((s[k:, k:] - s[:-k, k:] - s[k:, :-k] + s[:-k, :-k]) / (k * k)).astype(np.float32)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- panels (loose parts of the raw mesh)
bm = bmesh.new()
bm.from_mesh(me)
bm.faces.ensure_lookup_table()
face_panel = np.full(len(bm.faces), -1, np.int32)
panels = []
for f in bm.faces:
    if face_panel[f.index] >= 0:
        continue
    pid = len(panels)
    stack, comp = [f], []
    face_panel[f.index] = pid
    while stack:
        a = stack.pop()
        comp.append(a.index)
        for e in a.edges:
            for b in e.link_faces:
                if face_panel[b.index] < 0:
                    face_panel[b.index] = pid
                    stack.append(b)
    panels.append(comp)


def inside(vs, lo, hi):
    return all(lo[i] <= min(v.co[i] for v in vs) and max(v.co[i] for v in vs) <= hi[i] for i in range(3))


# Moving and glowing parts, picked by the bounding box of their panels (source frame): 1 trigger, 2 sight lenses.
face_part = np.zeros(len(bm.faces), np.int32)
for comp in panels:
    vs = {v for i in comp for v in bm.faces[i].verts}
    if inside(vs, (-0.0105, 0.116, -0.043), (-0.0005, 0.134, 0.0035)):
        face_part[comp] = 1
    elif len(comp) >= 15 and inside(vs, (-0.042, 0.104, 0.105), (0.031, 0.170, 0.140)) \
            and max(v.co.x for v in vs) - min(v.co.x for v in vs) < 0.006:
        face_part[comp] = 2
bm.free()
print("PANELS", len(panels), "trigger faces", int((face_part == 1).sum()), "lens faces", int((face_part == 2).sum()))
if not (face_part == 1).any() or not (face_part == 2).any():
    raise SystemExit("rifle_build_blend: trigger or lens panels not found")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- textures
col = load(color_im)
neon_raw = load(neon_im)[..., 0]
H, W = col.shape[:2]
lum = col[..., 0] * 0.2126 + col[..., 1] * 0.7152 + col[..., 2] * 0.0722

n_loops = len(me.loops)
uv = np.empty(n_loops * 2, np.float32)
me.uv_layers[0].uv.foreach_get("vector", uv)
uv = uv.reshape(n_loops, 2)
loop_start = np.empty(len(me.polygons), np.int32)
me.polygons.foreach_get("loop_start", loop_start)

ids = np.full((H, W), -1, np.int32)
hits = np.zeros((H, W), np.uint8)
for f in range(len(me.polygons)):
    p = uv[loop_start[f]:loop_start[f] + 3] * (W, H)
    x0, x1 = max(int(math.floor(p[:, 0].min() - 1)), 0), min(int(math.ceil(p[:, 0].max() + 1)), W)
    y0, y1 = max(int(math.floor(p[:, 1].min() - 1)), 0), min(int(math.ceil(p[:, 1].max() + 1)), H)
    if x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0:
        continue
    d = (p[1, 0] - p[0, 0]) * (p[2, 1] - p[0, 1]) - (p[2, 0] - p[0, 0]) * (p[1, 1] - p[0, 1])
    if abs(d) < 1e-9:
        continue
    px = (np.arange(x0, x1) + 0.5)[None, :]
    py = (np.arange(y0, y1) + 0.5)[:, None]
    w1 = ((px - p[0, 0]) * (p[2, 1] - p[0, 1]) - (p[2, 0] - p[0, 0]) * (py - p[0, 1])) / d
    w2 = ((p[1, 0] - p[0, 0]) * (py - p[0, 1]) - (px - p[0, 0]) * (p[1, 1] - p[0, 1])) / d
    m = (w1 >= 0) & (w2 >= 0) & (w1 + w2 <= 1)
    sub = ids[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    hits[y0:y1, x0:x1][m & (sub >= 0) & (sub != face_panel[f])] = 1
    sub[m] = face_panel[f]
covered = ids >= 0
print("ATLAS covered %.1f%%, texels claimed by two panels %.2f%%" % (100 * covered.mean(), 100 * hits.mean()))

neon = neon_raw > 0.5
valid = covered & ~neon
flat_ids, flat_l = ids[valid], lum[valid]
order = np.argsort(flat_ids, kind="stable")
sid, sl = flat_ids[order], flat_l[order]
cuts = np.searchsorted(sid, np.arange(len(panels) + 1))
med = np.full(len(panels), np.nan, np.float32)
area = np.zeros(len(panels), np.int64)
for i in range(len(panels)):
    seg = sl[cuts[i]:cuts[i + 1]]
    area[i] = len(seg)
    if len(seg):
        med[i] = np.median(seg)
# Panels too small to own a texel: brightness at the UV centre of their first face.
for i in np.where(np.isnan(med))[0]:
    c = uv[loop_start[panels[i][0]]:loop_start[panels[i][0]] + 3].mean(0)
    med[i] = lum[min(int(c[1] * H), H - 1), min(int(c[0] * W), W - 1)]
hist, edges = np.histogram(med, bins=20, range=(0, 1), weights=area)
print("MEDIAN HISTOGRAM (share of texels):", " ".join("%.2f:%.1f%%" % (edges[i], 100 * hist[i] / hist.sum()) for i in range(20)))

tone_of = np.array([next(k for k, t in enumerate(TONES) if m < t[0]) for m in med], np.int32)

# Padding: grow every island PAD texels into the empty atlas so filtering and mips never pull in a neighbour.
for _ in range(PAD):
    empty = ids < 0
    if not empty.any():
        break
    for dy, dx in ((0, 1), (0, -1), (1, 0), (-1, 0)):
        shifted = np.roll(ids, (dy, dx), axis=(0, 1))
        take = empty & (shifted >= 0)
        ids[take] = shifted[take]
        empty &= ~take
filled = ids >= 0
safe = np.where(filled, ids, 0)
pmed = np.where(filled, med[safe], 0.5)
ptone = np.where(filled, tone_of[safe], len(TONES) - 1)

# Small drawn details, re-cut with crisp edges. Dark ones (holes, panel lines) on panels that are not dark; light
# ones (markings) on dark and mid panels.
ratio = lum / np.maximum(pmed, 0.05)
dark = smoothstep(0.70, 0.50, ratio) * (pmed >= 0.24)
light = smoothstep(0.20, 0.34, lum - pmed) * (pmed < 0.42)
neon_a = smoothstep(0.35, 0.65, box_blur(neon_raw, 1))

tone_rgb = np.array([t[1] for t in TONES], np.float32)
tone_rough = np.array([t[2] for t in TONES], np.float32)
tone_metal = np.array([t[3] for t in TONES], np.float32)


def layer(base, value, alpha):
    return base + (np.asarray(value, np.float32) - base) * (alpha[..., None] if base.ndim == 3 else alpha)


base = tone_rgb[ptone]
rough = tone_rough[ptone]
metal = tone_metal[ptone]
for (rgb, r, m), a in ((DARK_DETAIL, dark), (LIGHT_DETAIL, light), (NEON_BASE, neon_a)):
    base = layer(base, rgb, a)
    rough = layer(rough, r, a)
    metal = layer(metal, m, a)
height = 1.0 - box_blur(np.maximum(dark, neon_a * 0.6), 1)

im_base = new_image("T_Rifle_BaseColor", base, True)
im_height = new_image("Rifle_Height", height, False)
im_mask = new_image("T_Rifle_EmissiveMask", np.repeat(neon_a[..., None], 3, 2), False)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- geometry
for o in scene.objects:
    o.select_set(False)
SRC.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = SRC
attr = me.attributes.new("part", "INT", "FACE")
attr.data.foreach_set("value", face_part)
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="EDIT")
bpy.ops.mesh.select_all(action="SELECT")
bpy.ops.mesh.remove_doubles(threshold=1e-5)
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="OBJECT")
bpy.ops.mesh.customdata_custom_splitnormals_clear()
me.polygons.foreach_set("use_smooth", [True] * len(me.polygons))
me.set_sharp_from_angle(angle=math.radians(SHARP_ANGLE))
mod = SRC.modifiers.new("WeightedNormal", "WEIGHTED_NORMAL")
mod.mode = "FACE_AREA"
mod.weight = 50
mod.keep_sharp = True
bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)
bm = bmesh.new()
bm.from_mesh(me)
print("WELDED verts", len(bm.verts), "tris", len(bm.faces), "open edges", sum(1 for e in bm.edges if len(e.link_faces) == 1),
      "edges with >2 faces", sum(1 for e in bm.edges if len(e.link_faces) > 2),
      "sharp edges", sum(1 for e in bm.edges if not e.smooth), "of", len(bm.edges))
bm.free()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- bake: normal (rounded edges + details) and AO
scene.render.engine = "CYCLES"
prefs = bpy.context.preferences.addons["cycles"].preferences
for kind in ("OPTIX", "CUDA"):
    try:
        prefs.compute_device_type = kind
        prefs.get_devices()
        for dev in prefs.devices:
            dev.use = True
        scene.cycles.device = "GPU"
        break
    except Exception as e:
        print("no", kind, e)
world = bpy.data.worlds.new("BakeWorld")
world.light_settings.distance = AO_DISTANCE
scene.world = world

mat = me.materials[0]
mat.name = "carabina_roja"
nt = mat.node_tree
nt.nodes.clear()
out = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial")
bsdf = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled")
nt.links.new(bsdf.outputs["BSDF"], out.inputs["Surface"])


def tex(image, x, y):
    n = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexImage")
    n.image = image
    n.location = (x, y)
    return n


t_height = tex(im_height, -900, -300)
bump = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 1.0
bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = DETAIL_DEPTH
nt.links.new(t_height.outputs["Color"], bump.inputs["Height"])
bevel = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBevel")
bevel.samples = 12
bevel.inputs["Radius"].default_value = BEVEL_RADIUS
nt.links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"], bevel.inputs["Normal"])
nt.links.new(bevel.outputs["Normal"], bsdf.inputs["Normal"])


def bake(kind, name, samples, **kwargs):
    image = bpy.data.images.new(name, BAKE_SIZE, BAKE_SIZE, alpha=False)
    image.colorspace_settings.name = "Non-Color"
    node = tex(image, -600, 300)
    for n in nt.nodes:
        n.select = False
    node.select = True
    nt.nodes.active = node
    scene.cycles.samples = samples
    scene.render.bake.margin = PAD
    scene.render.bake.margin_type = "EXTEND"
    bpy.ops.object.bake(type=kind, use_clear=True, **kwargs)
    nt.nodes.remove(node)
    print("BAKED", name)
    return image


im_normal = bake("NORMAL", "T_Rifle_Normal", 24, normal_space="TANGENT")
im_ao = bake("AO", "Rifle_AO", 96)
im_normal.pack()

ao = load(im_ao)[..., 0]
ao = np.clip(ao, 0.0, 1.0) * (1.0 - 0.45 * dark)
im_orm = new_image("T_Rifle_ORM", np.stack([ao, rough, metal], axis=2), False)
bpy.data.images.remove(im_ao)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- final material (Blender review; Unreal builds its own)
nt.nodes.remove(bump)
nt.nodes.remove(bevel)
nt.nodes.remove(t_height)
t_base, t_orm, t_nrm, t_mask = tex(im_base, -900, 400), tex(im_orm, -900, 100), tex(im_normal, -900, -200), tex(im_mask, -900, -500)
sep = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeSeparateColor")
nt.links.new(t_orm.outputs["Color"], sep.inputs["Color"])
mix = nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMix")
mix.data_type = "RGBA"
mix.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
mix.inputs["Factor"].default_value = 1.0
nt.links.new(t_base.outputs["Color"], mix.inputs["A"])
nt.links.new(sep.outputs["Red"], mix.inputs["B"])
